title: Shared definitions
description: Definitions shared by every engineering-conventions schema. Other schemas reference these with a relative $ref such as common.schema.json#/definitions/requirementId.

conventionId.description: A convention (document) identifier: EC- and four digits, e.g. EC-0002. Monotonic and never reused.

requirementId.description: A requirement identifier: a registered family prefix, a hyphen and a two- or three-digit number, e.g. GHA-07. Append-only and never reused.

familyPrefix.description: A requirement-ID family prefix: an upper-case letter followed by one to seven upper-case letters or digits, e.g. GHA.

slug.description: A lower-case kebab-case identifier, e.g. github-actions.

termId.description: A terminology term identifier: dot-separated lower-case kebab-case segments, e.g. gha.responsibility.validate.

version.description: A release version in MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH form, without a leading v, e.g. 0.1.0.

date.description: A calendar date in ISO 8601 form, YYYY-MM-DD.

severity.description: How a finding is reported: warning is reported without failing by default; error fails the check.

requirementStatus.description: Lifecycle of a requirement. proposed: published for comment and checked only by profiles that opt in; active: enforced; deprecated: still enforced, scheduled for retirement; retired: a tombstone that is never enforced and whose ID is never reused.

repository.description: A GitHub repository as owner/name, e.g. musher-dev/platform.

owner.description: A GitHub user or team handle, e.g. @octocat or @musher-dev/platform.

repoPath.description: A path relative to a repository root, written with forward slashes and no leading slash or ./ prefix.

pathGlob.description: A repository-relative glob with forward slashes: * matches within one path segment, ** matches across segments.

displayForms.description: Display forms keyed by lower-case identifier token: how the token is written in a Title-Cased name, e.g. api: API.
